bias: negative results/failed replications/brittleness; matched comparison first

non_regression.rule: Preserve config8 substantive negative-evidence role, CLEAN semantic boundary, exact tested-scope discipline, checkpoint-first single-effect-chain lifecycle, open-ended frontier, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, evidence/provenance, current-control freshness, recurring return semantics, and the dedicated-result-blocked receipt+LATEST fallback. Config9 adds only a fail-closed pointer-degraded recovery for the opposite write topology: an exact-readback dedicated result artifact and immutable own receipt exist for the completed effect chain while the mutable LATEST pointer CAS/write/readback is blocked. This may suppress duplicate replay of that exact completed attempt, but it must not elevate a search-level no-match into scientific negative evidence, weaken provenance, broaden scope, or add Work/manual/quota/cost dependency.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain a nonempty frontier and exact next action. Execute one highest-value checkpoint-first single-effect-chain substantive Phase-1 micro-slice, persist/read back exact continuation, then return recurring-open when frontier remains. Never intentionally consume an invocation until a hard runtime boundary.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that SHA; repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and refetch on changed control/config revision; freeze selected config after semantic start; quarantine/discard excess connector semantic payload.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve recurring negative-evidence execution after config6 and lifecycle-aligned bootstrap failed to prevent a later physical stop.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: Actual scheduler state found failure_evidence physically stopped again despite enabled_desired=true, config6 bounded slicing and lifecycle-aligned bootstrap. The earlier short-survivor canary was therefore transient and cannot support persistence closure.

preflight_checkpoint.timing: Immediately after authority bootstrap/freeze and own-state resolution, before optional/expensive public semantic work.

single_effect_chain.definition: Smallest safe substantive unit whose source/evidence lineage is complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back role-local checkpoint/output, immutable receipt where applicable and exact continuation. Do not begin another optional effect chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If material frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id and predecessor/resume identity so the next recurrence does not duplicate completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is lifecycle/scheduling output only; never semantic completion evidence and never a substitute for checkpoint/receipt.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker evidence and an alternative-route continuation, then return recurring-open; unavailable capability remains unresolved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current chain and continuation before more optional work when possible; resume later with backoff and no duplicate effect.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config9's pointer-degraded fallback weakens immutable provenance, exact tested scope, CLEAN isolation, role-valid scientific output, causes ambiguous chronology or duplicate suppression, or changes the existing config8 result-blocked fallback, increment config and repair; never disable the role, reintroduce intentional hard-boundary execution, or treat a write-surface workaround as scientific evidence.

write_surface_recovery_contract.trigger: A bounded public-source search or verification step completed under a valid frozen authority tuple, the role-local preflight was already persisted/read back, and only the dedicated result-artifact write is blocked by the scheduled-Chat/platform write surface while own LATEST and immutable own-receipt writes remain available.
required_durable_payload: search query or exact verification operation
source-qualified URLs or identifiers actually surfaced
write_surface_recovery_contract.fallback: Do not repeat the identical completed search merely because the dedicated result artifact could not be created. Persist the complete compact payload in the immutable own receipt and mirror it in LATEST using current-blob CAS/readback. Mark dedicated_result_artifact_status=blocked and result_record_status=durably_checkpointed_via_receipt_and_latest. Advance only the search-attempt/checkpoint frontier; do not increment scientific evidence/finding counters unless independent evidence rules are satisfied.
write_surface_recovery_contract.next_work: After exact readback, keep the same parent leaf unresolved when the requested witness was not found, but choose a non-duplicate next bounded query/source family/verification route for that leaf. No second optional effect chain in the same invocation.
forbidden: Treating a single-search no-match as evidence that the witness does not exist
Retrying the identical completed search solely to obtain a prettier artifact
write_surface_recovery_contract.recovery_failure: If neither a dedicated result artifact nor a complete immutable own receipt plus CAS/readback LATEST can be persisted, checkpoint only the exact blocker if possible and return recurring-open without semantic progress.

pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.trigger: A bounded effect chain completed under a valid frozen authority tuple; its preflight, dedicated result artifact and immutable own receipt were persisted and exact-read back as the same effect_chain lineage, but the mutable role-local LATEST pointer CAS/write/readback is blocked or fails.
pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.authority: The exact dedicated result artifact plus immutable own receipt pair is sufficient only to durably checkpoint completion of that search or verification attempt. In this branch LATEST is a convenience pointer, not the sole authority. Scientific evidence/finding counters remain unchanged unless independent evidence rules are satisfied.
pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.resume_resolution: On the next fresh bootstrap, if LATEST is stale but the exact result+receipt pair is source-qualified, same-role, same frozen-authority lineage and readback-valid, resolve that newest pair by repository chronology using the existing own_state_resolution fallback. Do not rerun the identical completed semantic operation solely to repair LATEST.
pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.pointer_repair: A safe LATEST repair may be performed only as zero-semantic-effect administration within the role's normal allowed write surface. Failure to repair must be recorded in the new receipt but must not consume another semantic search, force duplicate replay, or become scientific evidence.
pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.next_work: Keep the parent leaf unresolved unless independent evidence rules close it. Select exactly one next non-duplicate bounded effect chain from the preserved continuation and persist/read back its own artifact/receipt; no second optional effect chain.
required_receipt_fields: result disposition and exact scope guard
forbidden: Treating stale LATEST as loss of an exact-readback result+receipt pair
Repeating a completed search solely to repair pointer formatting
Promoting a search-level no-match to scientific negative evidence
pointer_degraded_recovery_contract.failure: If exact identity, same-authority lineage or provenance of the result+receipt pair cannot be independently reconstructed, fail closed, preserve the blocker, do not suppress replay on an unverifiable pair, and return recurring-open.

migration.reason: The first natural config8 FE-498 run persisted and exact-read back its preflight plus dedicated result artifact (blob 42ab0090acd7df230a09088c122dde12fea31a31) and immutable own receipt (blob ec12afe3591b9a978b342ae71255f99a84f7433e), but its mutable LATEST update was blocked and current LATEST remained at config7 FE-497 (blob aad8db7bca403634147346240a4ae04a4ad0bf1b). Config8 explicitly covers the opposite topology, where the dedicated result artifact is blocked while LATEST+receipt remain writable. Config9 makes an exact-readback result+receipt pair an authoritative search-attempt checkpoint only, suppresses duplicate replay solely to repair the pointer, and permits role-local chronological reconstruction to continue the next non-duplicate effect while the parent leaf remains unresolved.
migration.rollback_condition: If pointer-degraded recovery creates ambiguous predecessor chronology, duplicate-suppression mistakes, provenance loss, scientific-evidence inflation, CLEAN contamination, or any Work/manual/finite-quota/paid-cost dependency, increment config and repair; never disable the role or treat stale LATEST as scientific evidence.
